houses.name: Iron Horn General
houses.line: Hold the fords, crush the foe, victory is ours!

houses.name: High Wind Kite
houses.line: Hold the fords, watch the skies! No rider crosses KITE's watch unseen!

houses.name: General Orchid
houses.line: Stand firm, protect the fords, and let our banners fly over the valley!

houses.name: Iron Claw
houses.line: Hold the line. We do not chase; we wait. Let the river do the killing.
